key.name: bar-limits
key.summary: Limits shown in the top bar (API keys)

key.summary: Last usage response (numbers only, no token); lets the settings window list limits and draw its preview

key.name: short-labels
key.summary: Prefix each number with S / W / model initial (always on when 3+ numbers are shown)

key.name: number-mode
key.summary: Show percent used or percent left

key.name: color-by
key.summary: Colour by projected usage at reset (pace) or by usage now

key.name: color-enabled
key.summary: Tint the indicator green / amber / red

key.name: warn-at
key.summary: Amber from this percent used (usage colouring)

key.name: hot-at
key.summary: Red from this percent used (usage colouring)

key.name: countdown-mode
key.summary: When to show the countdown in the top bar

key.name: time-style
key.summary: Countdown as time left or as clock time
